summary: Update server: DefaultBaseURL (https://nexvirtualization.com/updates) is the built-in update source; the Release workflow (both forge copies) signs and publishes the system image to /srv/nex-updates on the website host with update-publish.py, pins the signed trust.json into the image, builds the image label in Debian form, and checks channel.json is reachable; update-publish.py gains prune; the website nginx template serves /updates/.

guide.reason: The default update server replaces the 'no built-in server' instruction and the publishing page describes the update tree and its secrets.

api.reason: The settings and status contracts are unchanged; an unset base_url now reads as the default URL instead of empty, documented in docs/API.md and the local OpenAPI.

roadmap.reason: Delivery plumbing for item 6 of the immutable Nex Core plan; no milestone status changed.

state.reason: The update source is host-local Core configuration and the published tree lives on the website host; the Controller keeps nothing.
state.record: Host /etc/nex/updates.conf (base_url=, channel=; default built in) and the website host's /srv/nex-updates tree. A fresh Controller reads both from Inventory.image.

verification.method: go test ./internal/nexupdate/... ./internal/localcore/...; python3 -m unittest tests.test_update_publish and the test_ci_security and test_release_version suites; scripts/generate_api.py --check; scripts/check_docs.py --worktree. On the website host: nginx -t, reload, and /updates/trust.json fetched through the public site. Not run: a full Release workflow, an update installed on a host, or a host built with the pinned trust.
